claim: The expression 'Wavai dagabai' ('tank and dagaba') is used in contemporary Sri Lankan institutional heritage discourse to summarize a perceived pairing between irrigation and Buddhist sacred landscapes.
bounded_by: This establishes present-day institutional use of the expression. It does not establish when the phrase originated, that it was an ancient proverb, or that every historic tank-dagaba pairing followed one invariant social model.
notes: Promotes GF-SAS-20 only as reception/heritage discourse and prevents projection of the slogan unchanged into antiquity.
